name: @pipeworx/mcp-remotive

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Remotive's curated remote-only job board by free-text query, category slug, and/or company name. Returns job listings with title, company, location tags, salary range, job type, and apply URL.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All Remotive categories with slug and name.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Company profile + active listings by company slug.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-remotive forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the remotive pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
